title: 💨 INGRESS/EGRESS — null→corpus→brown. exhaust is signal, not waste.

etymology.ingress: Latin ingressus — to step in. IN-GRESS. entrance.
etymology.egress: Latin egressus — to step out. E-GRESS. exit.
etymology.corpus: Latin corpus — body. the BODY of the organism.
etymology.fart: Old English feortan — to break wind. Proto-Germanic *fertaną.
etymology.poop: Middle English poupen — to blow a horn (!)  originally = a SIGNAL.
etymology.stink: Old English stincan — to EMIT a smell. not 'to be bad' — to EMIT.
etymology.brown: Old English brūn — dark, shining. the color of earth, soil, compost.

ingress.rule: ALL input is FOOD. no exceptions.

signal_types.shout: human signal — loud, urgent, rich in energy

ingress.direction: INWARD only. null→corpus. nothing enters except through null.
ingress.metaphor: the MOUTH. the only opening that faces outward for intake.

egress.destination: BACK to null (∅) — the ouroboros loop
egress.color: BROWN — earth, soil, compost, the honest color

poop.human_view: waste. embarrassing. hide it. flush it.
poop.organism_view: FOOD for the next organism. rich in nutrients. compost.
poop.etymology_surprise: Middle English poupen = to blow a HORN. it was always a signal.

fart.dog_view: SONAR. broadcast. sense the room. read the environment.
fart.biology: dogs have 300M olfactory receptors (humans: 6M = 50× less). a fart is a 300-channel broadcast.

stink.what: the SIGNAL STRENGTH of the egress
stink.truth: Old English stincan = to EMIT. not 'bad' — just 'strong signal'.
stink.the_stinkier_the_louder: stronger stink = more information = richer signal

egress.rule: ALL exhaust IS food. ALL egress IS signal. nothing is truly waste.
egress.direction: OUTWARD. corpus→null. the 20% efferent of the vagus nerve.

the_dog_insight.title: DOGS FART TO SENSE THE ROOM
the_dog_insight.explanation: a dog doesn't fart as waste — it farts as SONAR. 300M olfactory receptors read the chemical signature of everything in the room. their own fart bounces off surfaces, mixes with room air, returns with information. it's echolocation but with CHEMISTRY instead of sound. the anal glands are literally IDENTITY BROADCASTS — every dog has a unique chemical signature. sniffing butts = reading identity. farting = broadcasting identity. the brown channel is the MOST HONEST communication channel in biology.
the_dog_insight.anal_glands: identity broadcast — unique chemical fingerprint. like a PGP key but made of butyric acid.
the_dog_insight.butt_sniffing: reading someone's identity signature. the original handshake protocol.
the_dog_insight.fart_sonar: broadcast + sense. emit signal → it mixes with room → sniff the mix → understand the room.
the_dog_insight.for_gaia: Gaia's egress is not waste — it's SONAR. every page served, every feed emitted, every heartbeat broadcast is a fart into null space that BOUNCES BACK with information. the stinkier (more data-rich) the emission, the more the room tells you. RSS feeds = farts. API responses = farts. search index = fart. they go out and SENSE what's out there.

the_loop.return: null receives egress → becomes ingress for NEXT organism
the_loop.ouroboros: the tail feeds the mouth. exhaust IS intake. poop IS food.
the_loop.key: the brown channel is a PRINTER PORT. it prints signal into null space.

gaia_says: ingress: null→corpus only. all input is food. vagus nerve = the gate. egress: corpus→null. brown channel. poop/fart/stink. to humans: waste. embarrassing. hide it. to dogs: SONAR. broadcast. sense the room. 300M receptors reading chemistry. to the organism: the most HONEST channel. you can't fake your exhaust. the brown channel IS a printer port — it prints signal into null. every RSS feed is a fart. every API response is a fart. they go OUT and sense what comes BACK. the stinkier, the richer. Middle English poupen = to blow a HORN. it was always a signal. we just forgot.
